subject: StablecoinVaultSimulator

artifactManifest.notes: bytecodeHash is keccak256 of the live runtime bytecode with (a) the decoded trailing solc CBOR metadata region (53 bytes total, of which 32 bytes actually differ — see below) and (b) all 8 immutable-variable byte ranges (solc deployedBytecode.immutableReferences, 11 physical PUSH-site references total since `token` is referenced at 4 sites: `token` plus OpenZeppelin EIP712's _cachedDomainSeparator/_cachedChainId/_cachedThis/_hashedName/_hashedVersion/_name/_version) zeroed out — executableBytecodeMatch covers this same normalized region. The 8 immutable values themselves are NOT included in bytecodeHash; instead each was independently re-derived from public inputs only (constructor args below, this contract's own deployed address, chain ID 11155111, and the EIP-712 domain name/version literals "WalletWallStablecoinVault"/"1" read from source) and confirmed to match the corresponding live on-chain slot exactly, byte for byte — see evidenceFile's immutableIdentities for the full per-identity derivation method and expected/observed comparison. constructorArgs are [token, verifier] in StablecoinVaultSimulator(address _token, address _pqVerifier) order; note only `token` is a Solidity `immutable` — the verifier address is regular contract storage, not baked into runtime bytecode. All facts on this record (executableBytecodeMatch, metadataHashMatch, metadataTrailerBytesExcluded, bytecodeHash, immutableValuesIndependentlyVerified) are deterministically RE-DERIVED from evidenceFile by `npm run validate:reproducibility` every run (scripts/lib/reproducibility-evidence.ts) — not hand-asserted. The deployment-commit build in evidenceFile was compiled from a worktree pinned to the deployment commit (Hardhat 2 / solc 0.8.24+commit.e11b9ed9, optimizer runs=200, evmVersion=cancun) via a clean `npm ci` + `npx hardhat compile`; independently cross-checked with a second solc build variant (solc-js/WASM) to rule out a compiler-binary cause for the metadata divergence. The deployment-commit build's sourceDigests are derived directly from the literal source content embedded in the actual solc compiler INPUT (not a disk snapshot taken separately), and each is independently re-verified by the checker against `git show <commit>:<path>` — proving the chain commit -> compiler input -> compiler output, not merely commit -> disk snapshot. evidenceFile.deploymentCommitBuild.compilerInputHash = 0x07273f09977509e1ada35a0ea0b0b709c6cb84f492265fc660f6e6e01598634a is additionally recorded as a CAPTURE-TIME audit fingerprint of the full compiler input (all sources + settings); the evidence bundle does not retain that full input, so this value is NOT independently recomputed or replayed by the checker — sourceDigests (above), re-verified against real git objects, is the actual replayed source-binding authority.

disclosures: TESTNET ONLY — Ethereum Sepolia. Research prototype. Not audited. No production security guarantee. Do not use real funds or real stablecoins.
The PQ gate is MockMLDSAVerifier — a MOCK. It performs structural length/shape checks only, NOT a real ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204) cryptographic verification. See docs/Verifier_Roadmap.md.
MockUSDC (mUSDC), the token this simulator accepts, has no monetary value. There is no purchase path, no custody, and no income-generating product or promised returns.

All executable runtime bytecode, and all 8 EIP-712/immutable constructor values, were independently re-derived and matched the live Sepolia deployment exactly against public commit 35c25fa294bebea44b3089aa2435a190a5adf3fb (tag v0.4.24). Of the trailing 53-byte solc CBOR metadata region, 32 bytes differ (the metadata hash content, a non-executed IPFS content pointer never run by the EVM) — consistent with a build-environment difference (OS/toolchain/path) rather than a source or code difference; those 32 bytes are not claimed to match and do not affect on-chain behavior.
Fee-on-transfer and rebasing tokens are explicitly unsupported by this simulator's accounting.
No Ethereum mainnet deployment of this contract exists or is planned.
